name: Delete Lattice Data
description: Delete a value at a writable lattice path (w/, o/, n/, t/). Example: w/scratch/temp-data (clean up workspace). Idempotent — deleting a non-existent path is a no-op.

path.description: Writable path to delete. Must start with w/, o/, n/, or t/.

output.description: Empty on success. Delete removes only the addressed value and never prunes parent hierarchy; success is conveyed by the job status.
